title: Current State — High-Risk Work During a Turnaround
subtitle: How high-risk work is authorized and run today, before TrackLynk.AI. The verification gap, where authorized work and actual work drift apart, is marked in red.
cycleTimeNote: Cycle times are labeled and illustrative.

steps.label: Contractor badges in at gate
steps.detail: Headcount goes to the gate system

steps.label: Permit issued in PTW system
steps.detail: Paper copy handed to the crew

steps.label: Crew walks to the unit
steps.detail: Permit conditions travel on paper, not in a system

steps.label: Is the job running where and how the permit says?
steps.detail: The question nobody can answer from a desk

steps.label: Manual spot check
steps.detail: Verify by radio, phone and foot — hours per check

steps.label: Weekly HSE stats compiled in Excel
steps.detail: Assembled by hand from several systems

steps.label: Mismatch found after the fact
steps.detail: Numbers disagree — an audit finding, a near-miss, or worse

gapSummary: That is the verification gap: authorized work and actual work drift apart precisely where nothing is recording either one.

interventions.currentStep: Manual spot check by radio, phone and foot
interventions.intervention: Fuse permit status with live worker and asset location into one queryable view
interventions.impact: Hours of manual verification replaced by a live view

interventions.currentStep: Verify whether the job matches the permit
interventions.intervention: Automatically flag any job in a hazard zone without a valid permit
interventions.impact: Mismatches caught in the moment, not after the fact

interventions.intervention: Resolve gate, permit and timesheet sources to one trusted number with an evidence trail
interventions.impact: One defensible figure for muster and audit

interventions.currentStep: Decide what to fix before the next shift
interventions.intervention: Recommend the two or three highest-value actions and hand them off
interventions.impact: Faster, consistent decisions handed to shift supervisors
